name: authored-dml
description: Small authored DML corpus. Facts are reviewed independently from every analyzer output.

procedure_wrappers.postgres: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION {schema}.{name}() RETURNS void LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ {body} $$
procedure_wrappers.sqlserver: CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE {schema}.{name} AS BEGIN {body} END
procedure_wrappers.oracle: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE {schema}.{name} AS BEGIN {body}; END;

sqlite_setup: CREATE TABLE dml_source (source_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL, note TEXT, group_id INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE dml_source_extra (source_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, multiplier INTEGER NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE dml_target (target_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, target_value INTEGER, target_note TEXT, group_id INTEGER, last_writer TEXT)
CREATE TABLE dml_update_delta (target_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bump INTEGER NOT NULL, replacement_note TEXT, active INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE dml_merge_source (target_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, target_value INTEGER NOT NULL, target_note TEXT NOT NULL)

sql_overrides.oracle: INSERT INTO DMLACC.DML_TARGET (TARGET_NOTE, TARGET_ID, TARGET_VALUE, LAST_WRITER) SELECT s.NOTE, s.SOURCE_ID + 100, s.AMOUNT * 2, 'insert_permuted' FROM DMLACC.DML_SOURCE s WHERE s.ACTIVE = 1 AND s.AMOUNT >= 10

cases.name: update_from_delta
cases.body: UPDATE dml_target AS t SET target_value = t.target_value + d.bump, last_writer = 'update_delta' FROM dml_update_delta AS d WHERE d.target_id = t.target_id AND d.active = 1

sql_overrides.sqlserver: UPDATE t SET target_value = t.target_value + d.bump, last_writer = 'update_delta' FROM dbo.dml_target AS t JOIN dbo.dml_update_delta AS d ON d.target_id = t.target_id WHERE d.active = 1
sql_overrides.oracle: UPDATE DMLACC.DML_TARGET t SET (TARGET_VALUE, LAST_WRITER) = (SELECT t.TARGET_VALUE + d.BUMP, 'update_delta' FROM DMLACC.DML_UPDATE_DELTA d WHERE d.TARGET_ID = t.TARGET_ID AND d.ACTIVE = 1) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DMLACC.DML_UPDATE_DELTA d WHERE d.TARGET_ID = t.TARGET_ID AND d.ACTIVE = 1)

cases.name: merge_upsert
cases.body: MERGE INTO dml_target AS t USING dml_merge_source AS s ON (t.target_id = s.target_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target_value = s.target_value, target_note = s.target_note, last_writer = 'merge_upsert' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (target_id, target_value, target_note, last_writer) VALUES (s.target_id, s.target_value, s.target_note, 'merge_upsert')

sql_overrides.postgres: MERGE INTO public.dml_target AS t USING public.dml_merge_source AS s ON (t.target_id = s.target_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target_value = s.target_value, target_note = s.target_note, last_writer = 'merge_upsert' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (target_id, target_value, target_note, last_writer) VALUES (s.target_id, s.target_value, s.target_note, 'merge_upsert')
sql_overrides.sqlserver: MERGE dbo.dml_target AS t USING dbo.dml_merge_source AS s ON t.target_id = s.target_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target_value = s.target_value, target_note = s.target_note, last_writer = 'merge_upsert' WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (target_id, target_value, target_note, last_writer) VALUES (s.target_id, s.target_value, s.target_note, 'merge_upsert');
sql_overrides.oracle: MERGE INTO DMLACC.DML_TARGET t USING DMLACC.DML_MERGE_SOURCE s ON (t.TARGET_ID = s.TARGET_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.TARGET_VALUE = s.TARGET_VALUE, t.TARGET_NOTE = s.TARGET_NOTE, t.LAST_WRITER = 'merge_upsert' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TARGET_ID, TARGET_VALUE, TARGET_NOTE, LAST_WRITER) VALUES (s.TARGET_ID, s.TARGET_VALUE, s.TARGET_NOTE, 'merge_upsert')

sqlite.reason: SQLite has no MERGE statement; SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL variants are validated in their native environments.

cases.name: temp_chain_insert
cases.body: CREATE TEMP TABLE dml_temp_stage AS SELECT s.source_id + 400 AS staged_id, s.amount * 3 AS staged_value FROM dml_source AS s WHERE s.active = 1; INSERT INTO dml_target (target_id, target_value, last_writer) SELECT staged_id, staged_value, 'temp_insert' FROM dml_temp_stage

sql_overrides.postgres: CREATE TEMP TABLE dml_temp_stage AS SELECT s.source_id + 400 AS staged_id, s.amount * 3 AS staged_value FROM public.dml_source AS s WHERE s.active = 1; INSERT INTO public.dml_target (target_id, target_value, last_writer) SELECT staged_id, staged_value, 'temp_insert' FROM dml_temp_stage
sql_overrides.sqlserver: SELECT s.source_id + 400 AS staged_id, s.amount * 3 AS staged_value INTO #dml_temp_stage FROM dbo.dml_source AS s WHERE s.active = 1; INSERT INTO dbo.dml_target (target_id, target_value, last_writer) SELECT staged_id, staged_value, 'temp_insert' FROM #dml_temp_stage;
sql_overrides.oracle: CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE DMLACC.DML_TEMP_STAGE ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS SELECT s.SOURCE_ID + 400 AS STAGED_ID, s.AMOUNT * 3 AS STAGED_VALUE FROM DMLACC.DML_SOURCE s WHERE s.ACTIVE = 1; INSERT INTO DMLACC.DML_TARGET (TARGET_ID, TARGET_VALUE, LAST_WRITER) SELECT STAGED_ID, STAGED_VALUE, 'temp_insert' FROM DMLACC.DML_TEMP_STAGE

sqlite.query: SELECT target_id, target_value, last_writer FROM dml_target WHERE last_writer = 'temp_insert' ORDER BY target_id

cases.name: temp_chain_update

sql_overrides.postgres: CREATE TEMP TABLE dml_temp_delta AS SELECT target_id, bump + 5 AS bump FROM public.dml_update_delta WHERE active = 1; UPDATE public.dml_target AS t SET target_value = t.target_value + d.bump, last_writer = 'temp_update' FROM dml_temp_delta AS d WHERE d.target_id = t.target_id
sql_overrides.sqlserver: SELECT target_id, bump + 5 AS bump INTO #dml_temp_delta FROM dbo.dml_update_delta WHERE active = 1; UPDATE t SET target_value = t.target_value + d.bump, last_writer = 'temp_update' FROM dbo.dml_target AS t JOIN #dml_temp_delta AS d ON d.target_id = t.target_id;
sql_overrides.oracle: CREATE GLOBAL TEMPORARY TABLE DMLACC.DML_TEMP_DELTA ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS AS SELECT TARGET_ID, BUMP + 5 AS BUMP FROM DMLACC.DML_UPDATE_DELTA WHERE ACTIVE = 1; UPDATE DMLACC.DML_TARGET t SET (TARGET_VALUE, LAST_WRITER) = (SELECT t.TARGET_VALUE + d.BUMP, 'temp_update' FROM DMLACC.DML_TEMP_DELTA d WHERE d.TARGET_ID = t.TARGET_ID) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DMLACC.DML_TEMP_DELTA d WHERE d.TARGET_ID = t.TARGET_ID)
